descriptionChirho: Nifal stem intransitive sense: to escape, slip away, flee from danger or pursuit (Arabic najaa/haraba, Korean 피했다/도망쳤다, Swahili -toroka/-okoka).
Piel stem causative sense: to deliver, rescue, or save someone from danger, death, or captivity (Arabic yunajjii/yunqidhu, Korean 구하다/건지다, Swahili -okoa/-komboa).
Hitpael stem reflexive sense: to deliver or extricate oneself, to slip away by one's own effort (Arabic najawtu/tanTaliqu, Korean 면하다/튀다, Swahili -okolewa/-toroka).
Hifil stem causative sense: to cause to escape, to rescue or deliver by external agency (Arabic yukhallisu, Korean 구하시다, Swahili -komboa).
Specialized biological sense across Piel and Hifil stems: to bring forth young, to lay eggs, to give birth (Arabic baaDat/anjabat, Korean 낳았다, Swahili -zaa).
